system.description:
You attempt to seal a target thought, into a never-ending cycle of circular thought, always ending on its previous answer.

Select one hostile creature you can see and reach within range, forcing them to make an Intelligence saving throw. This creature remakes its saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this jutsu on a success.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this Jutsu's effect.

Success: Affected creature is Confused until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature must spend its Action, on each of its subsequent turns recasting the same jutsu (of your choice) it cast on its previous turn at a +4-chakra cost increase. If the target did not cast a jutsu on its last turn, this jutsu immediately ends.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but also the creature also gains 2 ranks of Sealed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
